entries.zh: 撕破的纸有一道参差不齐的边缘。

entries.en: A raging river cut off access to the village.
entries.zh: 湍急的河流阻断了进入村庄的通道。

entries.en: The textbook defines the solar constant before discussing atmospheric absorption.
entries.zh: 教材在讨论大气吸收之前先定义了太阳常数。

entries.en: The recovered funds were returned to the public treasury.
entries.zh: 追回的资金被归还公库。

entries.en: The warship began to bear down upon the smaller vessel.
entries.zh: 军舰开始向那艘较小的船逼近。

entries.en: A push-down queue returns the last item entered first.
entries.zh: 下推队列先返回最后输入的项目。

entries.en: The rotary press printed newspapers at remarkable speed.
entries.zh: 轮转印刷机以惊人的速度印刷报纸。

entries.en: The subway station has an entrance beneath the library.
entries.zh: 地铁站有一个入口位于图书馆下方。

entries.en: The rubber garden hose reached the flower beds beyond the shed.
entries.zh: 花园橡胶软管一直伸到棚屋那边的花坛。
